Title: Galactic Golf Solitaire
Description:
Enjoy a relaxing round of Golf Solitaire, a fun and easy-to-play card game. The goal is to clear the board by matching cards that are one rank higher or lower than the one on the discard pile. Don’t worry about suits—just focus on the numbers! If you’re stuck, you can draw from the deck to keep the game going. Play at your own pace and see how many rounds you can win.

Perfect for a quick break or to unwind at the end of the day!
Instructions:
Objective: Clear the board by moving all cards to the waste pile.
Setup: 7 columns of 5 face-up cards; the remaining cards form the draw pile.
Gameplay: Click the card from the board to move it to the waste pile if it’s one rank higher or lower than the top card of the waste pile. Suits don't matter. Aces can be placed on Kings or Twos. If no moves are possible, draw a card from the draw pile.

- The level is completed when 3 conditions described above are met.
- If you get stuck, you can use hint at any time.

- Every successful kick adds to your country's score on the global leaderboard.

But be careful — your tray holds only 7 slots.

Instructions:
The goal is to find and mark all the mines hidden under the green squares. This is done by clicking on the squares to open them. Each square will have:

Description:
Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil is a First-Person shooter Survival Horror game inspired by Silent Hill and the Resident Evil series.

In the mist-shrouded ruins of a once-thriving American city, a war veteran returns home from the battlefield only to discover his greatest fight has just begun.

His daughter, Emily, has vanished. The last trace: a desperate call from a place that should no longer exist — a town swallowed by unnatural fog. As Daniel steps into the eerie streets, he quickly realizes something is horribly wrong. The city itself has become a living nightmare where humanity’s deepest sins have taken physical form and manifest as grotesque, twisted monsters that stalk the fog-choked alleys and decaying buildings.

Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil is a love letter to classic survival horror, rebuilt for modern first-person immersion. Are you ready to face the monsters your sins created?

Title: Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana
Description:
Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana is a fast-paced hack-and-slash action game set in a breathtaking post-apocalyptic world buried beneath endless sands and the ruins of a fallen civilization. You step into the role of Black Ninja, the last surviving shinobi of the legendary Order of Light, awakened from cryogenic sleep long after the Great Fall—a catastrophic event orchestrated by ruthless factions seeking absolute power.

Armed with a razor-sharp katana and driven by vengeance, Black Ninja embarks on a dangerous journey to protect the innocent, uncover the truth behind humanity’s collapse, and confront powerful enemies standing in his way. Experience fluid sword combat, responsive movement, and satisfying hack-and-slash gameplay as you cut through hordes of foes and challenge formidable bosses.

Progress your hero by unlocking new abilities and becoming an unstoppable force in a world desperate for salvation. From abandoned cities swallowed by sand to haunting remnants of lost technology, every environment is crafted to immerse players in a striking vision of the future.

Kurofune Samurai is a free third-person action samurai game set in 19th-century Japan. The story is about a samurai who is called to help by the people of an oppressed village. His goal is to take the rights of the people from the oppressive ruler and fight with the ruler's guards and ninjas .

The people of Shizukana had a good life. The lord who ruled over them acted justly. One day a delegation from the American government asked for a trade agreement with the lord of the region, but he refused. The Americans equipped the lord's brother Akumo and incited his brother against him. With the help of American military weapons, he won and ruled Shizukana. Akumo was a stubborn and violent man, and his oppression of the people of Shizukana gradually increased. He had enslaved the people and anyone who could not provide the required product was severely and cruelly punished. Exhausted, the people decide to ask an old samurai for help. After hearing about the oppression, the samurai agreed to help and set out to investigate and rescue the villagers.
